description: This file defines an Android Activity named ContactDetailActivity that displays detailed contact information. It manages the lifecycle, handles intent data for contact URIs, and sets up fragment transactions to display contact details, as well as navigation via the action bar.

classes.name: ContactDetailActivity
classes.description: Defines an Android FragmentActivity that initializes a contact detail fragment based on intent data and manages navigation interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the Activity's onCreate method to initialize the activity, set up the UI, enable strict mode if in debug mode, check intent data, and add the ContactDetailFragment if not already added.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, specifically the home (up) button, to navigate up in the activity hierarchy using NavUtils.
